title: CreateIcosahedron
description: Tool to create an icosahedron with optional tessellation.

lin_depth.description: Number of edge divides for linear icosahedron tessellation.
lin_depth.title: Linear Depth

min_nodes.description: Automatically select the -ld value which produces an icosahedron of at least MIN_NODES nodes.
min_nodes.title: Minimum Nodes

nums.description: Output the number of nodes (vertices), triangles, edges, total volume, and total area then quit.
nums.title: Output Numbers Flag

nums_quiet.description: Output numbers in a less verbose manner.
nums_quiet.title: Quiet Output Numbers Flag

center_coordinates.description: Coordinates of the center of the icosahedron.
center_coordinates.title: Center Coordinates
